// Generated by media/build.py. Independent assets; no main-app registration.
export interface VideoLessonSource {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly organization: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly url: string;
  readonly accessedOn: string;
  readonly supports: string;
}
export interface VideoLessonCheckpoint {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly atSeconds: number;
  readonly prompt: string;
  readonly choices: readonly { readonly id: string; readonly text: string; readonly feedback: string }[];
  readonly correctChoiceId: string;
  readonly pausePlayback: true;
  readonly resumeAtSeconds: number;
  readonly replayFromSeconds: number;
}
export interface VideoLesson {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly category: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly language: 'en';
  readonly durationSeconds: number;
  readonly video: { readonly src: string; readonly mimeType: 'video/mp4'; readonly width: number; readonly height: number; readonly fps: number };
  readonly poster: string;
  readonly subtitles: readonly { readonly src: string; readonly srcLang: string; readonly label: string; readonly kind: 'subtitles' }[];
  readonly transcript: string;
  readonly narration: { readonly kind: 'synthetic'; readonly engine: string; readonly voice: string; readonly rate: number; readonly externalServiceUsed: false; readonly captionAlignment: 'approximate-phrase' };
  readonly chapters: readonly { readonly startSeconds: number; readonly endSeconds: number; readonly title: string }[];
  readonly checkpoints: readonly VideoLessonCheckpoint[];
  readonly cues: readonly { readonly startSeconds: number; readonly endSeconds: number; readonly text: string }[];
  readonly sources: readonly VideoLessonSource[];
  readonly safety: { readonly purpose: 'general-education'; readonly clinicalReview: 'not-clinically-reviewed'; readonly individualTreatmentAdvice: false; readonly fictionalExamples: true };
  readonly production: { readonly renderer: 'Manim Community'; readonly rendererVersion: string; readonly scene: string; readonly sha256: string };
}
